title: Engine hard crashes completely when zooming out in 3D
body:
### Tested versions

Tested both in v4.5.1 and v4.6.1 stable versions.

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9579) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (12 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

The editor runs at high frames, buttery smooth with no lag spikes whatsoever, but if I fly back or zoom out to a certain distance, the editor just completely closes. I opened Godot in --verbose and gathered the following logs at crash:

While stripping down a duplicate of my main scene to make an MRP, I found it comes down to one child scene I added. It seems to cause this crash in any new project, so I included the scene on its own in the MRP section.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open included scene below
- Zoom out or fly away a certain distance
- Crash
